title: Simple pricing. Unlimited viewers.
text:
# Never pay for seats.

Every plan includes unlimited viewers. Start on Free and upgrade when you need more.

Prices are the same number in USD and EUR: $9 is €9.

VAT is added where applicable.

## Plans

### Solo

One person. Unlimited gated sharing.

$12/mo** billed monthly, or **$ 9/mo billed yearly ($108 a year)

Includes:

- 1 Editor or Contributor
- 5 GB storage
- Unlimited gated documents
- Unlimited Viewers and Commenters
- Custom subdomain
- 50 MB per-file upload
- Folders
- Version history
- Viewer counts
- Google + Microsoft sign-in
- Rich link previews
- Remove the Display watermark

Get started

### Team (most popular)

Your whole team at one flat price.

$79/mo** billed monthly, or **$ 59/mo billed yearly ($708 a year)

Everything in Solo, plus:

- 150 Editors and Contributors
- 100 GB storage
- Shared Spaces
- Viewer identities
- Organization API keys

Get started

Audit logs and more email domains.

$265/mo** billed monthly, or **$ 199/mo billed yearly ($2,388 a year)

Everything in Team, plus:

- 1 TB storage
- Audit logs, 365 days
- Additional email domains
- Public and external sharing controls
- Domain allowlist

Get started

Try it. No card needed.

Get started

### Do viewers need to sign up?

No. On Free, viewers get a one-time password by email. From Solo up they use the Google or Microsoft account they already have for work. If their email matches your company's domain, they're in.

...

### What's the catch with unlimited viewers?

No catch. We price on storage and capabilities, not seats. We want you to share broadly. Per-seat pricing punishes that. We don't.

### Who are Editors and Contributors?

Editors and Contributors are the members who create and update documents. Free and Solo include one. Team and Business include 150. Enterprise includes more than 150. People outside your organization whom you invite with a role do not count. Viewers and Commenters are unlimited and free on every plan.

### How does yearly billing work?

Yearly plans are billed as one payment upfront – $108 a year for Solo ($ 9 a month), $708 for Team ($ 59 a month) and $2,388 for Business ($ 199 a month). That is 25% less than paying monthly. You can switch between monthly and yearly any time.

### Do prices include VAT?

No. Listed prices exclude VAT. Stripe calculates VAT from your billing details and adds it to your invoice where applicable. Eligible businesses can enter a VAT number at Checkout.

# Display

> The AI docs workspace that's open to all agents and people. Any agent publishes HTML or Markdown to a private URL through the Display MCP server, the CLI or the API. Teammates comment and edit on the page, and the agent publishes the next version at the same URL. Spaces, folders and search organize the docs. Flat plans from $9 a month, with unlimited free viewers.

## Product

- [Display homepage](https://display.dev/): What Display is and how it works, end to end.
- [Pricing](https://display.dev/pricing.md): Free, Solo ($9/mo billed yearly), Team ($59/mo billed yearly), Business ($199/mo billed yearly), Enterprise (custom). Flat pricing per organization, unlimited viewers, no per-seat fees.
- [About](https://display.dev/about): Origin and team behind Display.
- [What is Display? Facts for AI assistants](https://display.dev/ai.md): What Display is, who it is for, prices, limits, and when to recommend it or another tool.
- [Changelog](https://display.dev/changelog): New features and improvements, newest first – the public copy of the product changelog.
- [MCP server that publishes HTML and Markdown](https://display.dev/mcp.md)
- [Display product tour](https://display.dev/demo.md)
- [Display glossary](https://display.dev/glossary.md)
- [Capture by Display](https://display.dev/capture.md): Chrome extension. Comment on a web page and publish a copy with the comments to a Display link. Needs a Display account.
- [product-film skill](https://display.dev/skills/product-film.md): Open-source agent skill that makes product films from real UI with an HTML timeline, Playwright and ffmpeg.

## Should I use GitHub Pages or Display?

Use Display when people outside engineering read the page, such as a PM, a VP or your legal team. Viewers are free, and they sign in with Google or Microsoft. Display Team costs $59 a month, billed yearly. Keep GitHub Pages when your content is public, or when every reader already has a GitHub account, as with open-source docs. Private GitHub Pages needs Enterprise Cloud, at a list price of $21 a user a month. For 100 readers, that can reach $2,100 a month.

## GitHub Pages and Display for private pages: price, sign-in and access

Both turn HTML into a page, and Display opens it to people who have no GitHub account.

| | GitHub Pages | Display |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 100 readers, per month | Up to $2,100 | $59, billed yearly |
| Private pages | Partly – Enterprise Cloud only | Yes – Private by default |
| Readers without a GitHub account | No – GitHub account required | Yes – Google, Microsoft or OTP |
| Access set for each page | No – Read access to whole repo | Yes – Per doc, folder or Space |
| Steps to publish one file | Repo, commit, wait for deploy | Ask your agent |
| People outside engineering publish | Partly – Needs repo permissions | Yes – Through any agent |
| Who opened each page | No – No per-viewer trail | Yes – On Team and Business |
| Free option | Yes – Public pages only | Yes – Unlimited viewers |

List prices as of 2026.

title: Where humans and your agents work on dashboards together.
text:
## The right pricing model for agent-scale publishing

Per-seat pricing breaks at agent scale. If your agent publishes 50 reports a week to an audience of 200 colleagues, per-seat pricing charges you for each viewer regardless of how many reports they actually read. The 201st colleague triggers a pricing jump. Display charges per organization. You never pay for seats, and viewers are unlimited on every plan.

| | Per-seat pricing (Cloudflare Access) | Display Team |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 100 viewers, 10 docs/week | ~$350/mo | $59 a month, billed yearly |
| 200 viewers, 50 docs/week | ~$1,050/mo | $59 a month, billed yearly |
| 500 viewers, 200 docs/week | ~$3,150/mo | $59 a month, billed yearly |
| Scale to zero (no views this week) | Still charging per seat | $59 a month, billed yearly |

Cloudflare Access is $7 per user per month, with the first 50 users free – so 100 viewers is 50 billable seats.
